start.title: Embed Builder
start.desc: Build an embed from scratch, import JSON, or continue from a saved embed.

builder.title: Embed Builder
builder.desc: Pick a property below. Some open a modal; for the others you simply type the new value as a message in this thread - emojis and mentions included.
builder.typedHint: Mentions & emojis render only in Description & Field value
builder.waitingFor: Waiting for your next message to set: {{property}}
builder.needsOne: Set at least one of these before saving or sending: {{list}}
builder.manageRequired: Saving, sending, and editing messages requires the Manage Server permission.
builder.placeholder: Your embed will appear here - pick a property below to get started.
builder.notYourBuilder: This builder belongs to someone else.

modals.valueHint: Leave empty to clear this property

save.title: Save embed
save.nameHint: Saving under an existing name overwrites it

send.webhookPlaceholder: Send via webhook to up to 5 channels
send.optionalHint: Optional - leave empty to use my own identity
send.webhookUrlHint: Optional - send straight to this webhook instead of creating one

edit.title: Edit an existing message
edit.linkHint: I can edit my own messages and my webhooks' messages

io.jsonHint: An embed object, an array of embeds, a full message, or a discohook.app link
io.guide:
**Importing from [discohook.app](https://discohook.app)**
Build your message there, then paste either a discohook **link** (share or data URL) or the JSON from its **JSON Data Editor** below.
-# JSON too long for one field? Continue in the next one - the fields are joined in order.
io.componentsDetected: That JSON is a Components-V2 message. Import it with the component builder: {{command}}
io.linkFailed: Couldn't read that discohook link. Share links expire after a while - export the JSON from the JSON Data Editor and paste that instead.

settings.overviewDescription: Reusable embeds for panels, greetings, and anything else - built with the embed builder.

descriptions.name: The name this embed is saved and referenced under
descriptions.openBuilder: Edit this embed's content in a builder thread

errors.invalidTimestamp: I couldn't read that as a time. Try `@time` or `now`, a unix timestamp, a date, or a `<t:…>` tag.
errors.invalidJson: That JSON couldn't be parsed into an embed.
errors.noThread: I couldn't create a builder thread here - use this in a regular text channel.
errors.noWebhook: I couldn't create or access a webhook in {{channel}}.
errors.invalidWebhookUrl: That doesn't look like a Discord webhook URL.
errors.webhookWrongGuild: That webhook belongs to a different server.
errors.webhookUnreachable: I couldn't reach that webhook - check the URL is still valid.
errors.webhookIdentityTooLong: That webhook name and avatar URL are too long to carry - use a shorter one or send via a webhook URL.
errors.tooLong: That embed exceeds Discord's length limits - shorten it and import again.
errors.notEditable: That message wasn't sent by me or one of my webhooks.
errors.isComponentsV2: That message uses Components V2 - edit it with the Component Builder instead.
errors.manageGuildRequired: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.

placeholders.title: Available Placeholders
placeholders.intro: Type these into any text field. They are replaced when the message is sent by the feature listed.
